sources.title: Hand-cut paper birds
sources.creator: Diana Beltrán Herrera
sources.rights: Artist-owned copyrighted imagery; linked for technique study only; no asset or traced contour included
sources.view: three-quarter bird sculpture, search-preview imagery inspected

analysis.construction: distinct body scaffold, short anatomically directed feather overlaps and visible branch/feet contact
analysis.material: opaque teal, blue and orange individual cut stocks with natural depth relief
analysis.microdetail: short directional vane ribs arranged along feathers, not regular all-over dots
analysis.light: light catches folded feather edges; color remains material-bound

crops.observation: Vanes step root-to-tip and remain linked at shoulder
crops.implementation_rule: preserve wing rig and add angled short tapered vane barbs that share the existing hinge; do not use drifting decoration

sources.title: Kingfisher hand-cut paper
sources.creator: Pippa Dyrlaga
sources.rights: Artist-owned copyrighted imagery; inspected only; no copying or distribution
sources.view: frontal papercut bird composition, search-preview image inspected

analysis.construction: one readable bird silhouette with intricate cut marks that follow anatomical regions
analysis.material: fine high-contrast paper stock; void and solid balance must keep cut bridges
analysis.microdetail: tail vane marks, curving cheek feather rhythms, wing feather shafts move in local feather direction
analysis.light: high-contrast negative-space marks require opaque neighboring paper

crops.observation: short tail texture and head markings are subordinate to the continuous species silhouette
crops.implementation_rule: add restrained tail shaft cuts and small nested cheek coverts; preserve throat and eye shape

sources.title: Paper nature scene and sculpted paper birds
sources.creator: Helen Musselwhite
sources.rights: Artist-owned; style study only, no embedded work
sources.view: paper bird and botanical arrangements at preview scale

analysis.construction: layer hierarchy and framing guide attention; not every surface receives uniformly bright motifs
analysis.material: solid colorful card and physically plausible edge shadows
analysis.microdetail: near vs far layer detail density varies
analysis.light: restrained depth highlights without alpha ghosting

feature_targets.source_observation: Repeated fine feather details align with each feather's growth axis and remain attached to shared wing
feature_targets.geometry_rule: two-sided short curving closed-stock ribs per primary, each computed in primary's root-to-tip coordinate system; grouped in the three existing wing-spot stocks with shared hinge
feature_targets.test_view: Kingfisher 960×540 and 540×960 at f175 with motion seek f222

feature_targets.source_observation: Kingfisher tail is short and discreet, with thin directional marks rather than a long decorative spray
feature_targets.geometry_rule: seven unchanged short rectrices, one restrained close-tone stock with tapered medial shafts
microdetails: twenty-eight subdued shaft flecks at full detail

feature_targets.source_observation: Warm ear covert region reads as part of the compact skull, not as a cartoon smile
feature_targets.geometry_rule: four to seven tapered flecks inside existing orange cheek region, same opaque paper material

notes.reference_gate: Source visuals studied at available image-preview scale; no permission to bundle artist crops. Linked crop bboxes are coarse focus suggestions, not calibrated source masks. Pixel-matched ArtCraft scores are not claimed.
notes.style_policy: Original paths with anatomical rules; never reproduce a copyrighted piece or copy shape silhouettes.
notes.art_gate: Native browser/FilmStage frames and independent 1×/3× critique are required before artistic approval. CI green is technical only.
